crossRefs.note: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;
I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

translations.web: so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
translations.bsb: So I am allotted months of futility, and nights of misery are appointed to me.
translations.kjv: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed
translations.asv: So am I made to possess months of misery, And wearisome nights are appointed to me.
